title: 물량 배분 자문 체크리스트 수동 검토 기록

criteria.scope: authenticated request requires explicit 20xx year and full WW-SS week; short week is never accepted or derived by the API
criteria.manualDisposition: PENDING, REVIEWED, NOT_NEEDED, or LATER only; memo is a client string of at most 1000 characters
criteria.sourceIdentity: non-empty safe string retained verbatim and never used as a path
criteria.storage: append-only private file events under the existing ignored distribution baseline directory; GET selects the latest event per sourceIdentity
criteria.idempotency: authenticated user plus year/week/requestId has an immutable event ID; same payload returns the existing event and a different payload returns 409
criteria.advisoryOnly: manual review status neither overwrites a machine finding nor asserts ERP parsing, registration, distribution, fixing, or processing success

crossYearFixture.description: A 2025 event for the same full week and source identity is never returned by the 2026 query.

dnspyEvidence.note: The checklist stores advisory-only private review events and has no SQL, ERP module import, or ERP mutation.
